text:
harper: Running the TypeScript quickstart after accepting an Okta invite — first API call returns 402 Payment Required on /v1/chat/completions. anyone seen this flow-blocker? :confused:

matt: which org and sample? paste the curl or SDK snippet?

harper: org id: org-sundance-e2e, sample: ts-quickstart. curl below:

harper: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
# HTTP/1.1 402
# {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"payment required"}```

tori: 402 indicates billing gating, not auth. did the org come from SSO provisioning?

harper: yes via SSO invite. the console after accept showed a bland success snackbar but no trial CTA or billing prompt.

matt: we've had an intermittent bug where SSO-provisioned orgs in pooled tenants don't get the trial flag set. Billing team can toggle temporarily while we fix the flow.

billing-squad: checked org-sundance-e2e: payment_source=null, trial_flag=false, created_via=okta. We can apply a short dev grant. Want us to authorize a one-off dev trial?

harper: please, need to run CI and smoke the quickstart. thanks.

billing-squad: applied 2M token dev grant (24h). propagation should be ~20s. case #12021 logged.

harper: re-ran after 25s  success! :tada: 200 OK and completions returned.

harper: couple of DX asks: 1) quickstart README should call out billing gating for first call and include `redwood billing status --org <org>` snippet 2) API 402 responses should include a console hint URL when possible (e.g., /console/orgs/org-sundance-e2e/billing) and a short actionable message 3) SDKs should raise a BillingRequiredError (or PaywallError) instead of generic HTTPError so apps can surface friendly UI 4) console: show trial CTA on SSO-invite accept or clearly state billing may be required for starters

tori: filing a devex ticket to add the README note and a small SDK change to map 402->BillingRequiredError. also adding a CLI helper RFC: `redwood orgs enable-trial <org>` for admins to recover quickly.

matt: will add instrumentation to the invite provisioning path to emit a metric when the trial toggle is skipped so we can alert and reduce manual flips.

harper: cheers. tagging @platform-sre in case network/routing side-effects need review.

devx-bot: created case #12021 "SSO invite leaves starter org without trial -> 402 on first call"; assignees: tori, console-team; priority: P2.
